💡Lighting the way from above with LUMENS! 

Large construction sites, infrastructure projects, mining operations, disaster zones, and other large-scale outdoor environments often require powerful lighting for extended periods, especially during night operations. Conventional ground-based lighting systems can be difficult to deploy across large areas, occupy valuable space, and become challenging to reposition as work areas change.

What if the lighting itself could rise above the work area and stay there for hours?

Agastya Aerospace (Yerramreddy Aerospace Pvt. Ltd.), an IIT Mandi Catalyst incubated startup founded by Nivesh Reddy Yerramreddy and Co-Founder P Raghavendra Rao, is addressing this challenge with LUMENS a tethered drone-based aerial lighting system designed to deliver powerful, continuous illumination from above.

Powered through a 10 kW ground-based tethering station, LUMENS is designed for extended-duration aerial operation, eliminating the need to rely solely on onboard battery capacity and allowing the aerial lighting platform to remain deployed for long periods.

With an impressive 700,000 lumens of aerial illumination, LUMENS is engineered for demanding environments, offering:
 🔹Up to 12 hours of continuous operation
 🔹17 m/s wind resistance
 🔹10 kW Tethering Station
 🔹700,000 lumens of aerial illumination
 🔹Continuous power through tethered operation
 🔹Flexible aerial deployment and repositioning

From construction and infrastructure to mining, defence, disaster response, emergency services, airports, railways, ports, industrial operations, and large outdoor events, LUMENS brings together aerial mobility, long-duration operation, and high-intensity illumination to overcome the limitations of conventional ground-based lighting.

LUMENS has already received a Purchase Order from a leading Indian infrastructure and engineering company, marking an important step toward the real-world deployment of next-generation aerial lighting technology.

The future of large-area lighting doesn't always have to stand on the ground.

From Startup Journeys to Real Questions: A High-Energy Startup Panel at City Camp!

One of the most engaging sessions at our City Camp on Essentials of Scientific Entrepreneurship at Veterinary Incubation Foundation @ TANUVAS was the Startup Journeys & Industry Perspectives panel.

We brought together founders and industry leaders who shared candid insights from their entrepreneurial journeys — the challenges they encountered, lessons they learned, and what it really takes to transform an idea into a growing venture.

🎤 The panel featured perspectives from:
🔹 Geethanjali Radhakrishnan – Founder & Managing Director, Adiuvo Diagnostics
🔹 Dr. Arumugam Muruganandam – Managing Director & Chief Scientific Officer, Affigenix Biosolutions
🔹 Deepak Rajmohan – Founder & CEO, GreenPod Labs
🔹 Dr. SANTOSH VYAS – Director, R&D Initiatives for Animal Nutrition & Health Solutions (South Asia), Kemin Industries

Moderated by Dr. Kavita Parekh, Venture Center, the conversation covered the realities of entrepreneurship, industry perspectives and the journey from scientific innovation to building a venture.

💬 And the best part?
The questions kept coming!

Participants actively engaged with the panelists, asking questions about entrepreneurship, funding, industry expectations, commercialisation, challenges faced by founders and the realities of building a startup.
The enthusiasm in the room made it clear that these real-world stories and honest conversations resonated deeply with the participants.

A big thank you to our wonderful panelists for openly sharing their experiences and making entrepreneurship feel more accessible, practical and real. Because sometimes, the most valuable lessons come not from a presentation — but from hearing someone say, “Here’s what actually happened when we tried it.” 🚀

What if an innovation ecosystem could enable more than just startups?

That’s the opportunity Mr. Raghuveer Kovuru sees as he takes on the role of Chief Executive Officer at VentureStudio.

His vision is to build at the intersection of 𝐤𝐧𝐨𝐰𝐥𝐞𝐝𝐠𝐞, 𝐢𝐧𝐧𝐨𝐯𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐫𝐞𝐩𝐫𝐞𝐧𝐞𝐮𝐫𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩, helping students discover entrepreneurship, researchers take ideas beyond the lab, founders access the right ecosystem, and industry discover new possibilities within the university.

It’s about bringing together people, ideas and opportunities that might otherwise never meet.

From 𝐀𝐡𝐦𝐞𝐝𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐝 𝐭𝐨 𝐆𝐮𝐣𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐭, 𝐆𝐮𝐣𝐚𝐫𝐚𝐭 𝐭𝐨 𝐈𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐚, 𝐚𝐧𝐝 𝐈𝐧𝐝𝐢𝐚 𝐭𝐨 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐰𝐨𝐫𝐥𝐝, there is a lot to build.

And that is exactly what makes it exciting.

𝐖𝐞𝐥𝐜𝐨𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐕𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐮𝐫𝐞𝐒𝐭𝐮𝐝𝐢𝐨, 𝐑𝐚𝐠𝐡𝐮𝐯𝐞𝐞𝐫. 🚀

A meaningful exchange between two innovation ecosystems. 🇮🇳🇯🇵

We were delighted to welcome Hisashi Nakazawa, Director, Kobe Trade Information Office in Singapore, Kobe City Government, to VentureStudio, Ahmedabad University.

The visit offered an opportunity to explore how we support innovation from research and prototyping to incubation and commercialization, particularly across healthcare, life sciences and deep-tech.

During the visit, Mr. Nakazawa toured our three facilities and got a closer look at the infrastructure and capabilities available to innovators. He also interacted with our startups, gaining firsthand insights into the problems they are solving, their journeys, and the process of building and scaling from an academic ecosystem.

With Kobe’s strong biomedical, medical-device and biomanufacturing ecosystem, and Ahmedabad’s growing innovation and entrepreneurship landscape, there is significant potential for knowledge exchange, cross-border collaboration and stronger bridges between our two ecosystems.

Thank you, Mr. Nakazawa, for spending time with us and for the engaging conversations. We look forward to exploring what we can build together.

Raghuveer Kovuru | Charu Jain | Dr. Arpit Shukla | Abhishek Jaiswal | Dhaval Pandya | Shanaya Patel | Ekshika Bhagtani
